audience: sales, support and service teams that call and text customers from JustCall

useCases.title: Review missed and recent calls
useCases.text: List calls by agent, direction, contact number or date range. Open one call to read its duration, status and notes.

useCases.title: Trace how a call was routed
useCases.text: Read the ring and routing steps of a completed call. Read the voice agent data of that call when an AI agent handled it.

useCases.title: Measure call performance for a period
useCases.text: Read the account call volume, average ring time, total duration, SLA performance, and connect and answer rates for a date range.

useCases.title: Read the text history with a contact
useCases.text: List the texts by contact number, direction or date range. List the threads of one SMS-enabled number.

useCases.title: Send one SMS from a JustCall number
useCases.text: Find the JustCall number to send from. Send one SMS to one contact number. It goes at once unless scheduled, and cannot be recalled.

useCases.title: Create a contact and set its DND status
useCases.text: Create a contact with a first name and phone number. Add or remove a contact from the DND, DNM or blacklist lists.
